channel.title: Homeowners of Texas — Homeowner Watch
channel.description: Automatically refreshed Texas homeowner data and legislative activity.

item.title: HB 1198 Introduced
item.description: Relating to a temporary exemption from ad valorem taxation of the appraised value of an improvement to a residence homestead that is completely destroyed by a flood or windstorm.

item.title: HB 1199 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the regulation of elevator mechanics, elevator apprentices, and contractors; requiring an occupational registration.

item.title: SB 402 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the requirements for the operational plan for certain general residential operations licensed by the Health and Human Services Commission.
